items.t: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
items.d: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
items.fullText: The financials Anthropic shared with investors this week suggest that its AI coding tool, Claude Code, is every bit the business success the frontier lab wanted. The company recorded an operating profit in the second quarter, and 900% net revenue retention — that is, spending from the same customers in Q3 2025 grew nine times in Q3 2026. Anthropic has focused on getting enterprise users to stick around and Wednesday announced a new suite of reporting tools designed to give those customers a more granular understanding of the value they get from their token spend. Using internal analytics and employee surveys, managers can view a team’s work over a given date range, what the team produced, how much it cost, and where its workflows broke down. Anthropic says it won’t use this data for model training by default. The reports will also offer recommendations on how to improve the results. Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic Image Credits: Anthropic This is a clear attempt to demonstrate the return on investment of Anthropic’s tools and to show customers how to improve it — a major concern among large customers. Anthropic is also creating pooled group budgets to allow teams to better manage token spending. Businesses have been hunting for that kind of information as they figure out how best to deploy AI tools. While usage among venture-backed firms is driving token spend, most of the Fortune 500 are not seeing major gains from deploying AI. Jellyfish, a company that makes tools for software developers, released a new report yesterday based on the use of agentic coding tools by 276,000 of its customers. Claude Code and other tools built on Anthropic models remain the most widely used in the survey, responsible for nearly a third of all proposed code changes submitted for review. items.d: Anthropic is weighing a retail offering of 15% to 20% of the shares available in the IPO, according to people familiar with the matter. items.fullText: 플랫폼·유통 플랫폼 AI가 최적의 AI 모델 선택해 코딩…깃허브, '코파일럿 퓨전' 공개 발행일 : 2026-10-29 02:16 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 제이 파리크 마이크로소프트(MS) 코어AI 총괄 부사장이 28일(현지시간) 미국 샌프란시스코 포트메이슨센터에 개막한 연례 행사 '깃허브 유니버스 2026' 개막 기조연설을 하고 있다. [사진=현대인 기자] 깃허브가 개발 작업에 맞춰 인공지능(AI) 모델을 자동으로 선택·조합하는 '코파일럿 퓨전'을 공개했다. 여러 AI 모델의 성능과 비용을 비교해 최적의 모델을 활용, 개발 속도를 높이는 동시에 AI 이용 비용을 줄인다. 깃허브는 28일(현지시간) 미국 샌프란시스코 포트메이슨센터에서 열린 연례 개발자 행사 '깃허브 유니버스 2026'에서 코파일럿 퓨전을 비롯한 신규 기능과 기업용 서비스 정책을 발표했다. 이날 공개한 '코파일럿 퓨전'은 코드 생성, 오류 수정, 복잡한 추론 등 개발 작업별 요구 성능과 비용을 분석한다. 이를 토대로 하나 이상의 AI 모델을 선택하고 실행 방식을 결정한다. 단일 모델을 활용하거나 여러 모델을 순차적으로 실행하고 결과를 교차 검토하는 방식이다. 개발자가 매번 모델을 직접 선택해야 하는 부담을 줄이는 게 핵심이다. 깃허브 '옥토버스 2026' 보고서에 따르면 지난 9월 AI 모델을 직접 선택한 코파일럿 이용자 중 61%가 복수 모델을 사용했다. 4개월 전 50%에서 11%포인트(P) 증가했다. 특히 개발 작업별로 적합한 모델이 다른 만큼, 모델 선택에 드는 부담과 AI 이용 비용을 늘어난 것으로 분석된다. 제이 파리크 마이크로소프트 코어AI 담당 수석부사장은 이날 기조연설에서 “코파일럿 퓨전은 여러 AI 모델을 조율해 더 낮은 비용으로 최첨단 수준의 성능을 제공한다”면서 “작업에 필요한 요소를 판단해 단일 모델 실행, 순차 실행, 상호 검토 등 최적의 실행 방식을 선택한다”고 말했다. 제이 파리크 마이크로소프트(MS) 코어AI 총괄 부사장 여러 AI 에이전트가 개발 프로젝트를 분담하는 기능도 선보였다. '코파일럿 프로젝트'는 개발자가 목표를 제시하면 여러 코드 저장소에 필요한 AI 에이전트를 실행하고 작업을 배분한다. 개발자는 하나의 화면에서 진행 상황을 확인하고 필요한 의사결정을 내릴 수 있다. 이는 지난해 여러 AI 에이전트를 통합 관리하는 '에이전트 HQ'를 공개한 데서 한발 더 나아간 것이다. AI가 코드 작성을 보조하는 수준을 넘어 복잡한 개발 업무를 수행하고 관리하도록 지원하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 코드 품질 검증 기능도 강화했다. '코파일럿 코드 리뷰 맥스'는 변경된 코드를 심층 분석해 심각한 오류를 탐지한다. '코파일럿 오토메이션'에는 이전 작업 결과를 분석해 개선안을 제안하는 기능이 추가됐다. 기업용 AI 서비스 과금 방식을 다각화한다. 깃허브 엔터프라이즈 고객은 별도의 코파일럿 구독 없이 AI 기능을 이용하고, 사용한 AI 크레딧에 따라 비용을 지불하는 신규 옵션을 선택할 수 있다. 기존 구독제도 유지, 기업이 AI 도입 규모와 비용을 유연하게 조절하도록 지원한다. AI 에이전트 확산에 대비한 인프라 투자를 확대한다. 깃허브는 올해 중앙처리장치(CPU) 코어 400만개, 고속 스토리지 160페타바이트(PB), 초당 50테라바이트(TB/s)의 네트워크 용량을 추가했다. 마이크로소프트(MS) 애저의 멀티 리전 환경으로 전환하는 작업도 내년 초 완료할 계획이다. 파리크 수석부사장은 “개발자의 역할은 직접 코드를 작성하는 것에서 수십, 때로는 수백개의 AI 에이전트 작업을 관리하는 방식으로 빠르게 바뀌고 있다”면서 “궁극적인 목표는 여전히 의미 있는 소프트웨어 개발 작업을 완수하는 것”이라고 말했다. 샌프란시스코= 현대인 기자 modernman@etnews.com

items.t: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
items.d: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
items.fullText: Google is making it easier for businesses to connect their apps to its AI experiences across Search and Gemini with the debut of its Connected Apps Platform. Introduced in Gemini and Google Search earlier this year, connected apps let users securely link and interact with popular third-party services, then use them to take specific actions. For instance, you could connect to Canva to design a flyer, or to YouTube Music to build a playlist. We’ve seen varying takes on the idea by other consumer-facing AI services like ChatGPT and Meta’s Muse. The premise is that such integrations could ultimately shift consumer behavior away from launching and using individual apps to instead using their favorite services through their preferred AI provider. However, to successfully capture and retain consumers’ attention, there have to actually be a wide range of connected apps to explore. Google’s idea is to open its doors to any business or developer that wants to reach users through Search or Gemini by allowing them to submit their own connected apps and monitor their performance. The platform preview is currently available in beta to developers in the U.S., and will allow developers to build and submit apps that can be used across Google’s products. To get started, developers would integrate with a cloud-hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server or Android MCP using the AppFunctions APIs, then use the Google Connected Console to register, test, and submit their app, Google explains. Essentially, this process lets devs connect their app to Google’s services so it can be used with the search giant’s AI features. Developers can also choose whether they want their app to be available via Search, the Gemini app, or both. After the app is live, developers can track traffic, latency, and error rates, and maintain control over their brand identity, such as their verified logos and authenticated accounts. AI가 학습자에게 대화 주제를 제시하고 흐름을 파악해 자연스럽게 다음 학습 단계로 이끈다. 여기에는 ETRI가 자체 개발한 30억~130억 개 매개변수 규모의 소형언어모델(SLM)과 범용 AI가 함께 사용된다. 대화 진행 상황에 따라 학습 단계를 조정하고 이미 나온 질문을 반복하지 않도록 하는 기능도 적용했다. 지난해 말 외부 기관이 외국인 학습자와 한국어 교사 등 102명을 대상으로 진행한 블라인드 평가에서 ETRI 기술의 응답 적절성은 93.8%로, GPT-4o-미니(91.0%)와 GPT-5.1(90.9%)보다 높았다. 대화 오류율도 18.6%로 두 모델(25.4%·23.7%)보다 좋았다. ETRI는 말하기뿐 아니라 읽기와 쓰기까지 지원하는 AI 튜터로 기술을 확대하고 있다. 스마트 글라스와 연계해 음성만으로 한국어를 학습하는 플랫폼도 개발 중이다. 이영애 기자 0ae@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 이영애 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 "AI 모르면 끝장"…CEO들, 대학으로 모인다 한국경제신문의 투자 전문 유료 플랫폼 '한경 프리미엄9'(www.hankyung.com/premium9)에 실린 기사입니다. VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
items.d: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.
items.fullText: Many investors stand to win big when Anthropic goes public. Stakes held by firms, including Menlo Ventures, Sequoia, Sound Ventures, and Spark Capital, are expected to return billions . Yet, according to Anthropic’s S-1 , none of those VC firms owns 5%, the threshold for being included in the principal stockholders’ table. That’s highly unusual. In a typical tech IPO, lead venture investors hold double-digit-percentage stakes in the startups they backed. The reason is Anthropic’s size. At its $965 billion private valuation, a 1% stake is worth nearly $10 billion, so, for example, Menlo’s roughly $14 billion position is only about 1.5% of the company, according to recently reported Bloomberg figures. While the venture firms may lack sizable percentage stakes, Anthropic sold large stakes to strategic partners, companies that are also its business partners. Indeed, Amazon is likely the single largest financial beneficiary of the IPO. Amazon first backed Anthropic in 2023 with a commitment to invest up to $4 billion in the AI company. Since then, Amazon has poured billions more into Anthropic. Instead of taking stock up front, Amazon structured much of its investment as convertible notes, a type of debt that converts into shares upon an IPO or sale. According to the S-1, Amazon holds convertible notes with $6.2 billion in principal outstanding as of June 30. That is Anthropic’s entire debt load. But as Anthropic’s valuation soared across successive funding rounds, the shares those notes will convert into became far more valuable. Amazon’s own filings valued its note holdings at $97.9 billion as of June 30. As the value of Amazon’s convertible notes surged, Anthropic had to record the growing value of what it owes on its books. It reported the adjustments on its income statement under “change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs,” a line that totaled $72.4 billion for the first half of 2026. KT가 자체 개발한 ‘오토 모델 라우터’는 질문의 난이도와 요구 품질, 비용을 분석한다. 간단한 요약·번역에는 경량 모델을, 복잡한 추론에는 고성능 모델을 배정하는 방식이다. 입력 문장에서 불필요한 표현을 제거하는 압축 기술도 적용했다. KT에 따르면 프롬프트 압축으로 약 20%, 모델 자동 선택으로 약 5%의 비용 절감 효과를 낸다. 예컨대 ‘다음 주 출장인데 월요일 오전에 서울에서 부산으로 가는 KTX 열차를 찾아줘’라는 질문을 ‘다음 주 월요일 오전 서울 부산 KTX’로 압축하는 식이다. 질문의 의미를 유지하면서 AI가 처리해야 할 토큰 수를 줄여 비용과 응답 시간을 단축한다는 설명이다. 이진형 KT AX사업본부장이 27일 서울 세종로 KT광화문빌딩에서 열린 기자간담회에서 '토큰팩토리' 사업에 대해 발표하고 있다. /사진=KT 제공 토큰팩토리만의 차별점은 국내에서 AI 추론을 직접 수행한다는 것이다. AI 모델 7개는 국내 KT 데이터센터에서 구동된다. 업스테이지 ‘솔라 프로4’, KT ‘믿음 K3.0’, 모티프 ‘모티프3’ 등 국산 모델 3종과 지푸AI의 ‘GLM-5.3-플래시’, 구글 ‘젬마4-31B’ 등 해외 오픈웨이트 모델 4종이다. 오픈웨이트는 모델의 가중치가 공개돼 자체 인프라에서 구동할 수 있는 방식이다. 이진형 KT AX사업본부장은 “해외 모델 제공사와 별도 계약을 맺고 국내 데이터센터에서 직접 추론 서비스를 제공하기로 했다”며 “데이터 처리를 국내에서 수행하는 소버린 AI 환경을 구현하는 데 의미가 있다”고 말했다. 연내 오픈라우터를 입점시켜 글로벌 AI 모델 500개 이상을 확보할 예정이다. 이에 따라 국산 모델, 오픈웨이트

items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Anthropic reveals $80 billion loss, huge spending spree ahead of IPO The company warned that AI could “pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity” as cybersecurity fears grow. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 AI startup Anthropic unveils its public IPO filing for the first time 03:17 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 26, 2026, 9:12 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 26, 2026, 11:16 AM EDT By Steve Kopack Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic on Monday unveiled its public IPO filing ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history. That offering, widely expected to come sometime in mid-November, could value the Claude developer at more than $2 trillion. That could surpass the current record holder, Elon Musk’s SpaceX, which raised $75 billion in an IPO in June that valued the rocket-AI-social-media firm at $2.1 trillion. The filing did not include a potential share price, the number of shares to be offered or a valuation for the whole company, all of which will be determined after Anthropic holds a “road show” with investors, prospective investors and its bankers. Monday’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission showed that Anthropic, like other AI firms, is splashing out unprecedented amounts of cash on cloud services to run its AI models. The company plans to spend at least $110 billion with Amazon for cloud services through April 2036 and another $120 billion with SpaceX through 2029. Anthropic also said it planned to spend $115 billion with Google and $45 billion with Microsoft, both through 2033, for computing infrastructure. The filing said that the company recorded revenue growth of “1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, 2026.” The cost of renting servers and chips grew by 300% over the same period. items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Elvis Presley’s rights holders sue Anthropic, saying it trained AI on his music Anthropic has said it “disagree[s] with the claims and intend[s] to defend this case fully.” Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Elvis Presley performs in 1955. Michael Ochs Archives / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 25, 2026, 3:11 PM EDT By Angela Yang and Austin Mullen The owners of Elvis Presley’s music have sued Anthropic, alleging it used his copyrighted lyrics without permission to train its AI models and generating infringing versions of his songs. In a lawsuit filed Friday, Authentic Brands Group, the licensing platform that controls Presley’s intellectual property — along with other companies, trusts and individuals who own rights to his music — accused Anthropic of infringing copyrights to 274 songs without any license or payment. These span some of Presley’s biggest hits, including “All Shook Up,” “Can’t Help Falling in Love,” “Don’t Be Cruel,” “A Little Less Conversation” and “Return to Sender.” “The Elvis Plaintiffs’ iconic collective catalog contains some of the most groundbreaking, revolutionary, influential, and enduring musical compositions in human history,” the lawsuit stated. The plaintiffs allege that the infringement has occurred throughout “the entire development” of Anthropic’s flagship Claude models and continues today as users generate outputs that reproduce copyrighted lyrics or create unauthorized adaptations of the songs. “As we say in the lawsuit, the Elvis Plaintiffs are guardians of, and highly protective of, Elvis’s song which are some of the most iconic of all time,” attorney Richard Busch wrote in a statement. A spokesperson for Anthropic wrote: “We disagree with the claims and intend to defend this case fully.” Elvis Presley performs circa 1975. European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements On Shopify’s internal benchmark, the post-trained model surpasses a leading frontier model in accuracy while cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster. Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations. October 21, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign: AI Clouds Building European AI Infrastructure Europe is home to world-class research, engineering talent, industrial expertise, data, the next generation of models and applications that requires large-scale computing close to where that knowledge resides. Regional AI clouds provide the infrastructure foundation on which model builders, enterprises and entire industries can grow. As AI factories scale, power becomes a constraint which makes it critical for every watt to produce more intelligence. Nscale is using the NVIDIA DSX Platform to coordinate power allocation with workload requirements.
